description: On a writable copy of the props fixture, INSERT INTO TP (Req) VALUES ('r') omits every other column, and INSERT INTO TP (Req, TxtDef, NumDef, DateF) VALUES ('r2', NULL, NULL, NULL) names columns with defaults and gives Null; both with dbFailOnError and DBEngine.Errors. Afterwards all rows of TP are read.
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
